name: cyberskill-design
description: CyberSkill Design System: tokens, React components and the showcase site.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n pkg,site -c yellow,blue "npm run dev -w @cyberskill/design" "npm run dev -w @cyberskill/site"
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run build -w @cyberskill/site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cyberskill/design && npm run typecheck -w @cyberskill/site
